content: Tomorrow is a new day; begin it serenely and with too high a spirit to be encumbered with your old nonsense.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Every sunrise offers an unblemished canvas. Approaching tomorrow with noble enthusiasm prevents yesterday's trivial grievances from poisoning the future.
practicalInsight: Wake up tomorrow with the deliberate intention to start fresh, untethered from old grudges.
reflectionPrompt: What 'old nonsense' will you refuse to carry across the threshold of tomorrow morning?
